Tier SASB: * Cast Time Down: Increases cast speed of soulbreak entry by X based on the soulbreak honing level
* Damage Up: Increases soulbreak entry damage dealt by X% based on the soulbreak honing level
* Damage Reduction Barrier: Grants X% Damage Reduction Barrier 1 to the user based on the soulbreak honing level
* Dual Blink 1: Grants Dual Blink 1 to the user, applied after the soulbreak finishes casting
* Extra Usage: Increases the limit on the number of times the soulbreak can be cast in a dungeon by X
* Heal Boost: Increases soulbreak entry healing by X% based on the soulbreak honing level
* SB Gauge Down: Reduces the soulbreak gauge cost of the soulbreak by X amount
* Stat Boon: Grants Soulbreak Hone Stat Boon X (25s) to the user at based on the soulbreak honing level after casting the soulbreak entry
* Guardian Summon Damage Up: Grants Guardian Summon +X% Boost based on the limit break honing level
* ATB Reduction: Grants status based on the soulbreak honing level
